pages.title: Color Sort Party
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Sort the liquids in Color Sort Party by pouring between tubes until each color is grouped together. Before pouring, check whether the move will leave room for another color. Use a booster if a tight layout leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Lumen Ruin Runner
pages.creator: MiniStar
pages.description: Explore ruins on the run in Lumen Ruin Runner. Jump past hazards and collect energy as you work your way through the levels. Watch for openings in the route so you can grab energy without running straight into the next obstacle.

pages.title: Variety Mecha
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pilot a combat robot in Variety Mecha and use its firepower against enemy machines. Keep track of where opponents are as the battle develops, and pick the next target before you get pinned down by incoming shots.

pages.title: Mountain Bus Driver
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Pick up passengers in Mountain Bus Driver and take them to their stops over snowy roads and through forest hills. Manage your speed before a sharp turn or steep climb. The narrow mountain passes leave little room for wide steering.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Vale
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear the bubble board against the clock in Bubble Shooter Vale. Aim each shot to join colors and open up a route to bubbles higher on the board. The game also offers a relaxing mode when you want to play without the timer.

pages.title: Royal Pin
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Pull pins to rescue the king in Royal Pin. Look at what each pin holds back before removing it and work through the puzzles in an order that keeps the royal family safe. Your progress goes toward rebuilding the castle.

pages.title: Taylor Dress Studio Preppy & Wild West & Glam
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style Taylor for a preppy outing, a Western look, or the stage in Taylor Dress Studio Preppy & Wild West & Glam. Try different hairstyles and makeup, then bring the outfit together with glasses, jewelry, or a hat.

pages.title: Grunge Chic Alt Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Build an alternative outfit in Grunge Chic Alt Fashion. Pair combat boots with a plaid skirt or ripped jeans, then try an oversized jacket or fishnets. Use smoky makeup, a bold lip, and layered accessories to finish your chosen look.

pages.title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Search the park for an exit in Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park. Collect items and follow clues to solve the puzzles between rides. Move carefully, and duck out of sight when the enemies roaming the park get too close.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Puzzle
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Reassemble sixteen character pictures in Italian Brainrot Puzzle. Drag one square to another position to swap the pieces, using edges and color transitions as clues. Get the whole image in place before the timer runs out to advance.

pages.title: Physics Balls
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Aim a volley at numbered bricks in Physics Balls. Choose an angle that sends the balls through more than one part of the board. Watch how they bounce between bricks and try to clear the layout with a single shot.

pages.title: Find The Cat - Cat Search
pages.creator: MagicFox
pages.description: Search black-and-white illustrations in Find The Cat - Cat Search. Tap every cat you find, checking the outlines and background for ones that blend into the scene. Clear the current picture to uncover a different location and a new set of cats.

pages.title: Spin Spin
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Rotate the wheel in Spin Spin and watch the traps as it turns. Use the drag controls to adjust your movement, and look for a path to the rewards that gives you space to avoid the next hazard.

pages.title: Zombies and Guns
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hold off the undead in Zombies and Guns. Move with WASD and shoot with the mouse, then use space to dash out of trouble. Grenades, placeable turrets, and weapon upgrades give you more ways to handle tougher levels.

pages.title: Traffic Tap Puzzle
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Keep an intersection moving in Traffic Tap Puzzle. Tap a car to stop it or send it through, and check the traffic from the other directions before you do. Get the vehicles across without a collision as the layouts grow busier.

pages.title: Incredible Kids Dentist
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Take patients through a dental checkup in Incredible Kids Dentist. Click or tap to examine their teeth and work through the steps the game shows you. Watch which tooth needs attention as you move between parts of the appointment.

pages.title: Red Light Green Light
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Hold the mouse button or space to run in Red Light Green Light. Release when the light changes, then wait for green to move again. Use the safe intervals to make up ground as you race the others toward the finish.

pages.title: Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Find ten pumpkins in each scene in Spooky Halloween Hidden Pumpkin. Search abandoned houses, graveyards, and foggy forests for shapes that blend into the scenery. Work across the picture carefully and try to finish faster for a better score.

pages.title: Hamster Combo IDLE
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Build up a hamster cell by cell in Hamster Combo IDLE. Click for cells or spend virtual currency to buy them. Invest in upgrades to make cells accumulate faster, then watch the model at the center change as your total grows.

pages.title: Candy Match 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Make matches and clear blockers in Candy Match 4. Combine bigger groups of the same candy for stronger power-ups and take on a variety of boards with Luffy the cat. Daily missions and challenges give you additional goals between levels.

pages.title: CityMix Solitaire
pages.creator: Broccoli Games
pages.description: Play card sequences to complete tasks in CityMix Solitaire. Join Vicky and her raccoon as you help restore a quiet town or follow the puzzles on a lost island. Each card challenge ties into what the characters are doing next.

pages.title: Chibi Doll Coloring & Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Color pictures and make anime-style characters in Chibi Doll Coloring & Dress Up. Work on a coloring page, then try the dress-up tools to change a doll's outfit. You can also use the character creator to put together a chibi avatar.

pages.title: Color Brain Test Games
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Turn the colored rings in Color Brain Test Games to work out each puzzle. Check how one turn changes the alignment of the other pieces, then adjust the next ring. Each board gives you a fresh arrangement to solve.

pages.title: Skibidi Dash
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take the Skibidi character through obstacle courses in Skibidi Dash. Click or tap to control it and time your moves around the hazards. Keep the run going as far as you can, and try other characters as you unlock them.

pages.title: Heart Box
pages.creator: RAD BROTHERS
pages.description: Move or break objects to guide Robby through Professor Rat's experiments in Heart Box. Think about what will fall or roll when you change the setup. After working through the physics puzzles, try the level editor to build one yourself.

pages.title: Nitro Speed
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Pick a sports car in Nitro Speed and use its nitro for a burst of acceleration. Drive through races in muscle cars and exotics, and watch for collisions that can leave the car in need of repairs.

pages.title: Snake Blockade
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Collect yellow points to lengthen your snake in Snake Blockade. A numbered barrier costs points to break through, so look for a low number before choosing a lane. Keep enough points to survive whatever blocks your route next.

pages.title: Magic Soccer
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Guide a soccer ball through magic-school puzzles in Magic Soccer. Click and drag to play, then watch how the ball moves through the setup. Find the path that solves each exercise and work your way through the magician's training.

pages.title: Graffiti Time
pages.creator: Miniduck
pages.description: Sneak through the streets with Mr. Fat Cap in Graffiti Time. Paint tags, use a double jump to cross obstacles, and stay clear of the patrol robots. Ride the mini cruiser and land kickflips to earn extra money.

pages.title: Super Oliver World
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Help Oliver get through a parallel world in Super Oliver World. Jump over traps, shoot at enemies, and break blocks for coins and power-ups. Use A and D to move and W to jump if you're playing with the keyboard.

pages.title: Tictoc Summer Fashion
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Follow the styling hints to make short videos in Tictoc Summer Fashion. Choose and buy makeup and clothes for each look, then see how many likes the reel earns. Put the money you make toward new pieces for the next video.

pages.title: Stickman vs Zombies
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Fight through zombie hordes in Stickman vs Zombies with throwing knives and sword combos. Pay attention to saw blades, fire, and explosive barrels as you move through the level. The traps can take down zombies as well as your fighter.

pages.title: Toon Drive 3D
pages.creator: AyyHey
pages.description: Start behind the wheel of an SUV in Toon Drive 3D and work through driving and parking challenges. Navigate each layout without rushing the tight turns. New vehicles open up as you progress, giving you more cars to try.

pages.title: Squid Gun Fest
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Choose gates that increase your weapon count in Squid Gun Fest. Keep the growing volley aimed at guards and obstacles, and build up enough firepower to take on the giant doll when it appears.

pages.title: Thrilling Snow Motor
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Ride a snow motorbike across raised platforms in Thrilling Snow Motor. Pick up coins on the way to the finish and line up the bike before leaving a ramp. The gaps punish turns in midair, so set your direction on the platform.

pages.title: Mystery Venue Hidden Object
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: Search a deserted town in Mystery Venue Hidden Object. Look through the scenes for the objects the game asks you to find. Check dim corners and busy areas carefully, since a target can blend in with the clutter nearby.

pages.title: Stunt Extreme Car Simulator
pages.creator: AvariGames
pages.description: Drive across narrow tracks and steep ramps in Stunt Extreme Car Simulator. Manage your speed against the mission timer without leaving the track. Approach the next slope with enough momentum to clear it and enough control to stay on course.

pages.title: RCC Car Parking 3D
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Follow the minimap to the parking bay in RCC Car Parking 3D. Watch the car's corners as you steer past walls, barriers, and other obstacles. Take the last turn slowly so you can straighten the car before reaching the marked spot.

pages.title: Stickman Armed Assassin Cold Space
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Infiltrate a space station in Stickman Armed Assassin Cold Space. Take on missions as an agent and use your weapons to deal with enemies inside the base. Check the area around you before pushing ahead to the next objective.

pages.title: Cyber Cars Punk Racing
pages.description: Race futuristic cars through a neon city in Cyber Cars Punk Racing. Take on career events, drive freely, or try Hot Pursuit and the battle arena. Earn your way to more cars and upgrades, or share a race with a second player.

pages.title: Super Tetris
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Fit falling shapes together in Super Tetris. Fill a horizontal line to clear it and make room for the next blocks. Try to keep the stack level enough to clear consecutive lines for a combo.

pages.title: Cellcraft.io
pages.creator: Agma
pages.description: Steer a cell with the mouse in Cellcraft.io and grow by eating rivals. Use space to split or W to eject food. Collect coins for craftable power-ups such as speed boosts and teleporting portals.

pages.title: Crazy Birds Kart Hidden Stars
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find ten stars in each picture in Crazy Birds Kart Hidden Stars. Click or tap the outlines you spot before time runs out. Repeated misses cost time, so check each corner of the scene carefully.

pages.title: Rusty Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide tiles into place in Rusty Cars Slide to restore pictures of weathered cars. Pick one of three images and choose a three-by-three, four-by-four, or five-by-five layout for it.

pages.title: Monster Truck Repairing
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Work on a monster truck in Monster Truck Repairing. Click or tap through the wash and repair activities to get the vehicle cleaned up and back in shape. Follow the tools the game provides as you move through the jobs.

pages.title: MathPup Truck Counting
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Count the items you load in MathPup Truck Counting, then deliver exactly that amount. Drive fast enough to climb the hills and use the tilt controls over bumps so your cargo stays in the truck.

pages.title: Stack Blocks 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Cover the empty squares in Stack Blocks 3D by laying the blocks out across the board. A block changes direction only when it meets an obstacle, so check where it will stop before setting it in motion.

pages.title: Dinasaur Hunt
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Hunt smaller dinosaurs and animals through a forest in Dinasaur Hunt. Approach quietly to avoid alerting prey, then press E to eat. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move between hunting spots.

pages.title: Mystery Pic
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Name what you see through the blur in Mystery Pic. Use the shape and colors you can make out to identify each picture. Spend in-game coins on a hint if an image leaves you stumped.

pages.title: Basketball Shoot
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Send the ball into the hoop in Basketball Shoot using a click or tap. Adjust your timing to get it through the basket and pick up coins as you play. Spend the coins on other balls or maps.

pages.title: Ambulance Trucks Coloring Pages
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Color one of sixteen emergency vehicle illustrations in Ambulance Trucks Coloring Pages. Drag to draw with the pencil, change its size for details or larger areas, and use the eraser to revise part of the picture.

pages.title: 8b Elegant Boy Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description: Find hidden objects and use clues to get out of the house in 8b Elegant Boy Escape. Click around the rooms and look at what you collect. Something you find early may help you solve a puzzle elsewhere.

pages.title: Valentines Puzzle
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Move hearts along open paths in Valentines Puzzle. Line up at least three of the same color in a row or column to clear space. Keep matching before the board fills and leaves you without a move.

pages.title: Santa Running
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Collect gifts with Santa in Santa Running. Click or tap to jump as obstacles approach, and time your landings so you can reach the next present. Work through 21 levels as the route changes.

pages.title: Digital Vehicles Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore pictures of digital vehicles in Digital Vehicles Slide. Choose from three images and three puzzle modes, then use the mouse to move the scrambled tiles. Look for bodywork and wheel details that continue across tile edges.

pages.title: Domino Falls 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Aim at a domino in Domino Falls 3D and send a shot into the setup. Look for a starting piece that will carry the chain reaction into the rest of the pattern. Try to knock down every domino.

pages.title: Crazy Kitchen Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find seven changes between the two pictures in each level of Crazy Kitchen Difference. Click or tap when you see a detail that differs. You have one minute per level, so keep moving across the scene.

pages.title: Ice Queen Halloween Party
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get the Ice Queen ready for a costume party in Ice Queen Halloween Party. Use the mouse to try the outfits, then choose Halloween makeup to go with your favorite costume.

pages.title: Clean Road 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive a snowplow in Clean Road 2 to clear a way for people to get home. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer around roadblocks. Keep the plow on a clear line when obstacles narrow the route.

pages.title: Foot Chinko
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Play soccer through pinball-style layouts in Foot Chinko. Send the ball toward the goal, using bounces to get around traps and defenders. Win matches across international tournaments and work toward filling the trophy case.

pages.title: Vampire Dress Up
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Give a vampire her own look in Vampire Dress Up. Change her eyes and lashes, pair a dress with jewelry and shoes, and set the look against a dark background. Save the finished outfit to the gallery.

pages.title: Math Dog Integer Addition
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Help MathPup catch a cat burglar in Math Dog Integer Addition. Add the positive and negative numbers, then pick the box with the right answer. Choose a skill level and try timed play when you want more pressure.

pages.title: Cute Unicorn Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Turn over unicorn pictures in Cute Unicorn Memory and look for identical pairs. Remember where each picture is when the tiles differ, then use what you saw on a later turn. Match every picture to finish the level.

pages.title: Sports Car Wash
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take sports cars through the wash in Sports Car Wash. Use WASD to control the car and follow the route for each level. Give yourself space to steer as you approach the washing area.

pages.title: BTS Mouse Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a mouse illustration in BTS Mouse Coloring and add your own colors. Click or tap to paint the drawing. Give the mouse a blue coat, a red tail, or any combination you want to see.

pages.title: Bee Happy Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guide a bee over the platforms in Bee Happy Adventure. Click or tap to make it hop, and judge when it needs to gain height before the next platform. See how long you can keep it moving.

pages.title: Bactrian camel Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Assemble Bactrian camel pictures in Bactrian camel Puzzle Challenge. Choose a difficulty and look for the outline of a hump, a patch of fur, or a matching background. Take your time with the untimed boards.

pages.title: Flap Up
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Click to flap upward in Flap Up. Watch the obstacles moving in from the sides and pass through when you have a clear opening. Pick up coins along the route and see how high you can go before a collision.

pages.title: Butterfly Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a butterfly illustration in Butterfly Coloring Book and paint it with the brush. Try repeating the same colors across both wings or giving each part of the pattern a different shade.

pages.title: Ellie Tongue Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat Ellie's swollen tongue in Ellie Tongue Doctor. Use the tools in the office to deal with the rash, then switch to her teeth. Clean them and fit braces to finish her visit.

pages.title: The Dungeon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Explore a two-dimensional dungeon in The Dungeon. Jump through the rooms and work around walls and obstacles as you move deeper. Save some space to react when you reach the fight with the orc boss.

pages.title: EG Hopping Boy
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Run and jump through the jungle in EG Hopping Boy. Cross platforms, pick up coins, and look ahead for enemies and gaps. Time your jumps to keep the boy moving through the themed stages.

pages.title: Speed Pinball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Use the flippers to knock the ball toward gems in Speed Pinball. Collect them before time runs out, and watch for pickups such as the magnet bar. Spend the gems on upgrades for later runs.

pages.title: Dolls Spring Outfits
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress the dolls for spring in Dolls Spring Outfits. Browse the seasonal dresses and try them with different accessories. Look at the whole outfit before choosing which pieces you want to put together.

pages.title: Summer lake
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Fish for bluegill, pike, and other species in Summer lake. Your catch earns money for bait, rods, and new fishing spots. Try different equipment as you work through the six locations and see what bites.

pages.title: City Blocks Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Drop blocks to build a tower in City Blocks Game. Tap when the moving block lines up above the stack. Keep the tower centered as it climbs and try to beat your previous score.

pages.title: Yacht Dice Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Roll five dice in Yacht Dice Game and choose which combination to score. Compare the possible categories before committing a roll. A good choice now can leave a better category open for a later turn.

pages.title: Christmas Integer Addition
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Add the numbers at the top of the screen in Christmas Integer Addition, then tap the Santa holding the sum. Check the signs before you answer, since a mistake costs both a life and points.

pages.title: Word Crush
pages.creator: Dfabrik
pages.description: Look through the letters for the target word in Word Crush. Compare each group of letters with the word you're given, then select it when you spot it. Find more words to score and advance.

pages.title: Spider Defense
pages.creator: ASR Online Games
pages.description: Deploy soldiers to stop giant mutant spiders in Spider Defense. Click or tap a clear spot to place a defender, then start the wave when you're ready. Cover the spiders' route before they reach town.

pages.title: Plumber Duck
pages.creator: 105games.com
pages.description: Rotate pipe segments in Plumber Duck to connect the wheel to the arrow. Use the mouse to turn each piece and follow the route from the start. Complete the connection to free the duck.

pages.title: Jumpanda
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Collect fruit to refuel Panda's rocket in Jumpanda. Keep the panda moving toward the fruit as you build up the supply. Get the rocket ready to fly so he can reunite with his girlfriend.

pages.title: Guess The Pixel: Comics
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Recognize comic-book heroes from pixel portraits in Guess The Pixel: Comics. Look for colors and costume details that give away Captain America, Wonder Woman, the Hulk, and others. Pick an identity for each portrait.

pages.title: Princesses Pregnant Selfie
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Style the expectant mothers for a group photo in Princesses Pregnant Selfie. Tap to try dresses, shoes, and hairstyles on each princess, then see how their looks go together before they take the selfie.

pages.title: Ice Princess Pool Time
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Get the Ice Princess ready for a day at the pool in Ice Princess Pool Time. Choose a swimsuit and try different accessories to go with it before she heads out for a swim.
